Solid sushi spot with small weaknesses
Apr 2026 • Couples
On our first evening we decided to go for sushi at Mayonaka. The restaurant offers a wide selection of sushi, which is also of good quality, but also not part of the cheaper side of Vietnam. 

The only downer was the attention of the staff that evening. We had to wait several times longer until someone took an interest in us. The employees were often on their phones, which had bothered us a bit. But this is due to the culture in Vietnam and if you are not embarrassed, you can always call the staff without any problems. 

In all, the Maykonaka was a good spot with good food.
